answer: Agents scale by reserving 1,000 distinct service slots, functioning as a digital oasis where a verifier tracks occupancy via latency probes. The system acts as a prism, splitting incoming traffic into unique paths to verify that each agent maintains its dedicated capacity. A vertex-locked timestamp marks every reservation, ensuring non-overlapping access. Honest agents pay 1x cost, while fakes pay 1,000x for isolated slots.
